content: विपरिणमनम्, विपरिणामः .²1 A change, an alteration. .²2 Change of form, transformation. .²3 One of the modes of construing a sentence according to which a word or expression in the sentence is changed so as to suit the general trend in the context. This change may pertain to विभक्ति, लिङ्ग, वचन, पुरुष, काल, अर्थ <ab>etc.</ab>; <ls>ŚB. on MS. 1. 2. 1</ls>.
